result.rationale: A single 400 mg ibuprofen dose at 26 weeks is very unlikely to cause harm; the concern (fetal renal effects, ductus closure, oligohydramnios) applies mainly to repeated/prolonged use, especially after 30 weeks. Shoulder pain has resolved, patient feels well, fetal movements normal. Guidance: avoid further NSAIDs during pregnancy, use acetaminophen for pain if needed, and mention the dose at the next routine prenatal visit; seek care if reduced fetal movement or other new symptoms.
